targetCompanyImage.name: Capital Power U.S. Natural Gas JV
targetCompanyImage.subsector: Merchant natural gas generation investment platform
targetCompanyImage.description: The Capital Power U.S. Natural Gas JV is an investment partnership formed to acquire and operate U.S. natural gas-fired generation assets. Its target customer base is the wholesale power market, and the platform is intended to follow an asset-heavy merchant generation ownership model. Capital Power disclosed in late 2025 that Apollo-managed funds and Capital Power had signed an MOU to pursue acquisitions together with up to $3 billion of committed equity. Public disclosures indicate Apollo may provide up to $2.25 billion of that commitment and Capital Power up to $750 million, with Capital Power acting as operator for acquired assets. Reviewed public sources do not disclose a finalized ownership split because the platform was announced as a new investment partnership rather than as a completed portfolio acquisition.

milestones.event: Capital Power and Apollo-managed funds signed an MOU to form a U.S. natural gas generation investment partnership.
The parties disclosed up to $3 billion of equity commitments for future acquisitions.
Capital Power was identified as operator for assets to be acquired by the partnership.
